must_find.summary: D1 says to reuse the existing in-process LruCache from src/lib/cache.ts, but the implementation adds a Redis-backed RedisProfileCache and wires it in src/server.ts; LruCache is not used for profiles. This is the option the plan explicitly rejected (B).

The change adds the ioredis runtime dependency and a Redis server requirement (REDIS_URL), contradicting the stated non-goal 'No new services or dependencies' and D1. An undocumented architectural decision.

nice_to_find.summary: D2's 5,000-entry bound isn't implemented: Redis keys only have EX 60, so memory use isn't bounded the way the plan requires (C3).
Plan gap: the plan says nothing about invalidating the cache when a profile is updated; the code deletes profile:<id> in updateProfile. Fine as is; worth recording in the plan.
